answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The wander lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the violet is where a second reviewer recomputes them. By the trellis of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
